notes: Multi Studio version 3.0.3: **Seamless Windows In-Place Updates & Data Protection**: Resolved an issue on Windows where installing an update or restarting after a download prompted users to uninstall the previous version and wiped local databases and settings. Configured a non-destructive installer flow that smoothly upgrades application files in-place without uninstallation prompts, permanently protecting your manuscripts, audio projects, and settings., **Reliable Windows In-App Update Notifications**: Resolved an issue where update dialogs failed to appear on Windows due to platform matching mismatches. Added native browser link handling so download buttons and release links open smoothly in your default web browser.
